usageGuidelines: 展示现有单个评分值使用 display；用户录入或修改评分使用 input；只有综合分值、评论总数与星级数量分布时使用 summary。包含评论媒体、分类筛选或评论列表联动的聚合区必须使用 Comment/rating-summary。display/input固定为5颗完整星，不生成半星输入；summary按统计分值裁切官方星图作为显示适配，视觉确认单列；等级形容词只使用业务明确提供的文案，本次仅证实 5 星可显示 Excellent。 原件Clear组合只显示星组与Clear，不与说明文字拼接；当前Clear有限调用仅用于来源明确的受邀评论页，不能泛化为所有评分表单。
responsiveRules: 本组件只定义 PC 端结构；不生成 Tablet/Mobile 专用重排或断点。
display 与 input 保持单行，尺寸与间距由 sm/md/lg 修饰类决定。
summary 保持 112px 分值卡与 160px 分布列的精简横向组合。

variantSelectionRules: 展示一个已有的整数评分值 → display，保持既有尺寸、官方星图与ARIA一致。
来源明确的受邀评论页录入或修改评分 → input，沿用既有Clear和整数范围。
综合分值、评论总数和5至1星数量分布 → summary，counts是唯一统计数据来源。
同时包含图库与筛选标签 → Comment/rating-summary，必须实际引用Rate/summary；业务查询由宿主接收事件。
商品配置、套餐或服务选择 → OptionSelector，不得用星级评分表达业务选项。
display/input不开放半星输入；summary小数星形仅为显示适配，等级形容词必须由业务提供。

hardRules.title: 固定完整五星，并区分评分输入与评论聚合
hardRules.description: 单值与输入保留完整五星；评分汇总从统计数量推导，不复制原件示例数字。
hardRules.ruleContent: display/input保持既有整数整星及Clear边界；summary使用官方on/off星图和计数数据，按一位小数分值做显示裁切。Comment负责媒体与标签并真实引用summary。
hardRules.aiParse: display/input integer-only; summary counts[5..1] derive one-decimal score,total,official glyph fill; no arbitrary color,size or fake review data
hardRules.enforcement: rate-current.js负责原整数输入及ds:rate-change；rate-summary-current.js从counts推导汇总并发出可取消ds:rate-filter；原维护同步校验Comment真实引用同一summary。

aiContract.selectionPolicy: 单值只读用display；邀评输入用input；综合分值、评价总数和5至1星统计用summary。summary仅接受五项统计数量和筛选事件，固定16px官方图标、浅灰评分块及88px统计条。带图库和标签用Comment/rating-summary，它真实引用Rate/summary。原input尺寸与Clear限制保持；小数汇总只做显示适配，不开放半星输入或自由配色。

identity.rule: Display/input preserve five full stars; aggregate summary uses five official SVG layers with documented decimal display cropping. Display on/off sequence, aria-label and optional label agree. Canonical input retains group, five radio buttons, hidden machine output and Clear, with locked data-rate-clear-only. Clear-only does not display explanation alongside Clear.
identity.labelRule: Business grade words must be supplied, not invented. Input groupLabel is nonempty; labels is five strings, empty entries fall back to numeric value.
identity.summary: 统计数量唯一驱动一位小数分值、官方星图显示、总数、分布及可访问标签；原件示例算术冲突保留在来源，不照抄成业务数据。

locked: Five official stars and finite sizes; display/input integer-only, summary count-derived display
Input radiogroup/radio and safe button types
Shared CSS and actual rate.js behavior
Count-derived summary,official SVGs,source geometry,semantic progress and cancelable filter; decimal visual clipping is a documented display adaptation
Canonical clear-only marker and hidden machine output; no visible explanation/Clear combination

behavior.display: No runtime display updater. Structured ratingContent must synchronize icons, aria-label and optional existing label.
behavior.initialization: Current runtime has one document guard and MutationObserver reconciliation for current inputs; no public setValue API. Do not load legacy rate.js alongside it.
behavior.preview: pointerover previews only icons while explanation/hidden state, data-value and aria-checked preserve the committed selection; pointerout restores committed stars.
behavior.commit: Star click, Clear and keyboard emit ds:rate-change even for repeated same value; detail contains value/previousValue/label/source.
behavior.keyboard: Arrows move from the focused button, Home/End select 1/5, Enter/Space commit current star; Clear selects 0 and focuses first star.
behavior.disabled: Runtime initializes disabled class or aria-disabled. Enabled canonical calls do not expose state editing; changing class after initialization does not synchronize runtime state.
behavior.business: No native form field or request. Host listens to the component event.
behavior.currentGuard: Current document guard prevents duplicate event handlers; native disabled fieldsets/explicit custom disabled state update controls and tabstops. Legacy Comment host input without marker is not automatically upgraded.
behavior.summary: Source-bound summary: gray score card,official16px on/off SVGs,88px progress; counts derive score,total and percentage. Hover/focus underline,Gray7 surface and white empty track;13px feedback; cancelable ds:rate-filter. Decimal star clipping is a documented display adaptation, not a new input variant or visual approval.
behavior.hover: Preview stars only; preserve committed explanation text and hidden state until selection. Source v1.2.2604A2.1/4.2.
behavior.clearOnly: Locked data-rate-clear-only keeps output hidden for initialization, hover, commits and Clear; callback data remains available. Unmarked generic input behavior unchanged.

ratingContent.rule: Five stars, selected size, synchronized aria-label, on/off sequence and optional existing label. No interaction or half-star.

notes.clearSourceBoundary: 中/大Clear原件160×20/204×24，间距12；Clear为TEXT而非TextButton。有限调用保留原生button键盘语义；隐藏output仅用于已有数据同步，不新增可见原件子项。无marker的通用runtime说明行为不变。
